description: Where Apdex is lost and where fixing pays most: application, module, screen, action, then the dependencies. Apdex = (satisfied + tolerating / 2) / requests, over screens and Reactive server calls: satisfied up to 3 s, tolerating up to 10 s, frustrated above. Both thresholds are bucket edges of atrium_outsystems_operation_duration_seconds.
